notes: W45C3B/W45D2 publishes only visually reviewed exact source regions from the user-generated evidence bundles.
Hipped roofs, rope bridges, railed bridge overlays, cement-platform topology and ambiguous roof trim remain deferred rather than guessed.
Raw pinned LPC sheets remain immutable authority; these records reference exact external source rectangles directly and generated runtime atlases remain optional caches.
W54A adds the exact brown flat-shingle nine-slice by palette-parallel source cells from the same pinned Flat Shingle Roof A sheet; topology is unchanged from reviewed gray cells.
